nodes.speaker: Newt
nodes.text: Cole! Cole. Listen. I've been working on my signals. This one means 'danger from the north'.

choices.text: That was a goose with a question.

nodes.speaker: Newt
nodes.text: It was a HAWK. Geese don't even— okay it might've drifted goose-ward at the end.

nodes.speaker: Newt
nodes.text: THANK you. Nobody in this town knows birds.
